tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists all Microsoft fabric workspaces user has access to. Provides details about the workspaces, including id, display name, description.

Roles.description: A list of workspace roles to filter by. Separate values using a comma. Valid roles are: Admin, Member, Contributor, Viewer. If not provided, all workspaces are returned.

ContinuationToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific Microsoft fabric workspace.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Creates a new Microsoft fabric workspace.

displayName.description: The display name of the workspace. Maximum length is 256 characters.

description.description: The description of the workspace. Maximum length is 4000 characters.

capacityId.description: The capacity ID to create workspace in (optional). uuid format

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.description: Updates a Microsoft fabric workspace display name or description.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

displayName.description: The new display name of the workspace (optional).

description.description: The new description of the workspace (optional).

tools.name: delete_workspace
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Microsoft fabric workspace and all its contents.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to delete. uuid format

tools.name: list_workspace_roles
tools.description: List all role assignments for a workspace.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ContinuationToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

RoleAssignmentId.description: The role assignment ID. uuid format

id.description: Principal ID (User, Group, or Service Principal)

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Lists all Microsoft fabric items user has access to. Provides details about the items, including id, display name, description.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ContinuationToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

RootFolderId.description: Filter items by root folder ID (optional). uuid format

Recursive.description: True to include nested folders, false to restrict to the specified folder only. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get metadata for a specific Microsoft fabric item.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ItemId.description: The ID of the item. uuid format

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Creates a new Microsoft fabric item.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

displayName.description: The item display name. The display name must follow naming rules according to item type.

description.description: The item description. Maximum length is 256 characters.

folderId.description: Folder ID to create the item in (optional). uuid format

creationPayload.description: Item-type specific payload. Use either creationPayload or definition, but not both.

definition.description: The item definition. The Create Item page of the relevant type indicates whether the definition is supported and details its structure. Use definition or creationPayload. You can't use both at the same time.

format.description: The format of the item definition.

payloadType.description: The content of the definition part.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update item metadata (display name, description).

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ItemId.description: The ID of the item. uuid format

displayName.description: The new display name of the item (optional).

description.description: The new description of the item (optional).

tools.name: delete_item

ItemId.description: The ID of the item. uuid format

tools.description: Retrieves the definition of a Microsoft fabric item. this definition is a representation of the item and its state without the data.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ItemId.description: The ID of the item. uuid format

Format.description: The format of the item definition (optional).

tools.name: update_item_definition
tools.description: Updates the definition of a Microsoft fabric item. item definition is a representation of the item and its state without the data.

WorkspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace. uuid format

ItemId.description: The ID of the item. uuid format

UpdateMetadata.description: True to apply metadata updates when the .platform part is provided.

definition.description: The item definition. The Create Item page of the relevant type indicates whether the definition is supported and details its structure. Use definition or creationPayload. You can't use both at the same time. If using item definition, You must submit all the required parts, not a partial patch.

format.description: The format of the item definition.

payloadType.description: The content of the definition part.

tools.name: get_operation_state
tools.description: Returns the current state of the long running operation. You get the operationId from the x-ms-operation-id header returned by the API that initiated the operation, you should use the Retry-After header to determine when to check the operation status again. Once the operation status is 'Succeeded' use the Get Operation Result API to retrieve the result.

operationId.description: The ID of the operation. uuid format

tools.name: get_operation_result
tools.description: Returns the result of the long running operation. You get the operationId from the x-ms-operation-id header returned by the API that initiated the operation.

operationId.description: The ID of the operation. uuid format

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches the Microsoft Fabric OneLake catalog for items matching the specified criteria. Supports cross-workspace search over catalog metadata and returns results filtered to entries the calling principal is authorized to access.

search.description: The text query for the search. Supports searching across display name, description and workspace name of the catalog entry.

pageSize.description: The page size that needs to be returned.

filter.description: The filter for the search. Supports filtering by type of entries. Supported operators: eq (Equals), ne (Not Equals), or (Logical OR), () (Parentheses for grouping). Example: "Type eq 'Report' or Type eq 'Lakehouse'". Supported item types: Dashboard, Report, SemanticModel, PaginatedReport, Datamart, Lakehouse, Eventhouse, Environment, KQLDatabase, KQLQueryset, KQLDashboard, DataPipeline, Notebook, SparkJobDefinition, MLExperiment, MLModel, Warehouse, Eventstream, SQLEndpoint, MirroredWarehouse, MirroredDatabase, Reflex, GraphQLApi, MountedDataFactory, SQLDatabase, CopyJob, VariableLibrary, Dataflow, ApacheAirflowJob, WarehouseSnapshot, DigitalTwinBuilder, DigitalTwinBuilderFlow, MirroredAzureDatabricksCatalog, Map, AnomalyDetector, UserDataFunction, GraphModel, GraphQuerySet, SnowflakeDatabase, OperationsAgent, CosmosDBDatabase, Ontology, EventSchemaSet (additional types may be added over time).

continuationToken.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Use this tool for gathering knowledge on specific topics. The output will be in markdown format.

topics.description:
Include the list of topics you need context for. The allowed topics and the summary of the context they provide are as follows:
- Notebook: Provides context on the Notebook Item Definition which is used when creating or updating a Notebook Artifact.
- Dataflow: Provides context on the Dataflows Item Definition which is used when creating or updating a Dataflow Artifact.
- Lakehouse: Provides context on the Lakehouse Item Definition which is used when creating or updating a Lakehouse Artifact.
- Report: Provides context on the Report Item Definition which is used when creating or updating a Report Artifact.
- SemanticModel: Provides context on the Semantic Model Item Definition which is used when creating or updating a Semantic Model Artifact.
